request.prompt: Create a 5-second, fully 2D animated clip in the style of classic Scooby-Doo. Use the person in V2 as the character reference, preserving his glasses, hair, beard, and outfit, all fully drawn. In a spooky mansion hallway with crooked portraits, cobwebs, and flickering lamps, the terrified person runs left to right while a goofy, lumbering green monster chases close behind. Use one continuous side-tracking shot, keeping both characters visible. 0-2 seconds: The person sprints with exaggerated cartoon strides while the monster reaches toward him. 2-4 seconds: He glances backward, eyes widening, then accelerates with comically spinning legs. 4-5 seconds: Both race through an open doorway and disappear offscreen. Bold ink outlines, flat cel shading, hand-painted purple-and-teal backgrounds, expressive faces, elastic cartoon movement, and playful spooky slapstick. No photorealism, 3D rendering, gore, text, or changes to the person's identity.
